# SD18 deterministic Human Barbarian level 14 widening fixture.
# Widens the accepted SD18 deterministic PF1 Core Rulebook Human Barbarian
# level-1..level-13 martial chassis baseline
# (tests/sd18_barbarian_level13_widening.rs) to level 14 as chosen
# input only. It names selections; it does not contain derived, computed, or
# parity values. It preserves the accepted Human race-choice seam
# (ability-bonus and bonus-feat) and the deterministic
# ability/feat/skill/equipment posture from the level-1 through level-13
# fixtures, adding only the level bump this bounded tranche needs. 14th
# level IS a rage-power level (powers land at 2/4/6/8/10/12/14 per "she
# gains another rage power for every two levels of barbarian attained after
# 2nd level"), so a seventh numbered slot's choice line is added; the sixth
# slot's line from the level-13 fixture carries over unchanged.
#
# It deliberately avoids every later Barbarian burden surface: no rage
# execution (activation, round tracking, fatigue), no rage-power EFFECT
# recognition or execution beyond the bounded numbered-slot idiom, no
# damage-reduction application engine, no saving-throw-resolution engine for
# Indomitable Will, and no level-15+ progression. The PF1 Core Rulebook
# Barbarian class table's level-14 "Special" column reads "Indomitable will,
# rage power" (verified independently against d20pfsrd and the Archives of
# Nethys aonprd.com mirror): Indomitable Will is a genuinely NEW named class
# feature, grounded as a fifth flat while-raging magnitude (a +4 morale
# bonus on Will saves to resist enchantment spells and effects while
# raging), mirroring exactly the shape of the four pre-existing flat rage
# constants; Trap Sense stays +4 (14/3, next rise 15th), Damage Reduction
# stays 3/- (next rise 16th), and base saves stay Reflex/Will +4 (14/3, both
# integer-division coincidences) while base attack and Fortitude genuinely
# rise.
case_id=pf1-crb-human-barbarian-level14
source_package_id=pf1.core_rulebook
race_id=race:human
class_level=class:barbarian:14
ability=strength:16
ability=dexterity:14
ability=constitution:16
ability=intelligence:8
ability=wisdom:10
ability=charisma:8
feat=feat:power_attack
skill=skill:survival:1
equipment=item:chain_shirt:equipped_worn_active
equipment=item:longsword:equipped_primary_active
equipment=item:shield:absent
choice=choice:level_1_character_feat:feat:power_attack
choice=choice:human_bonus_feat:feat:dodge
choice=choice:barbarian_rage_power_6:power:superstition
choice=choice:barbarian_rage_power_7:power:guarded_stance
choice=choice:human_ability_bonus:ability:strength
